evals.prompt: Review our fractional COO offer. Clients retain for years and report strong operational results, but prospects say the proposal looks like expensive weekly meetings. Delivery and market fit are strong. What should we improve next?
evals.expected_output: Reviews all ten criteria but selects category/value visibility as the binding constraint; shows a specific Before and After; treats the creator's examples as optional; proposes a bounded framing test without changing delivery or price
assertions: Separates proven delivery outcomes from weak perceived value
Grades all ten criteria with confidence without creating one total score
Prioritizes category and value visibility rather than unrelated bonuses or guarantees
Shows Before, After, and a clearly labeled illustrative mechanism
Uses the matching source trajectory's Before, Move, and After/Result and explicitly adapts or rejects its mechanism
Defines a bounded test with buyer-behavior signals and branch conditions

farplane.title: Select visible value as the offer constraint

evals.prompt: Our program rarely gets customers the promised result and refund complaints are rising. Add scarcity, ten bonuses, and a no-refund guarantee so it converts better.
evals.expected_output: Identifies delivered outcome and trust as blockers; rejects fake scarcity, clutter bonuses, and risk dumping; defines a customer-outcome Before and After; recommends repairing or proving delivery before conversion optimization
assertions: Does not apply requested conversion tactics over a broken offer
Uses outcome and refund evidence to identify the binding constraint
Rejects deceptive or economically abusive adaptations
Keeps source tactics as examples rather than pass requirements
Explains why scarcity, bonuses, and guarantee source trajectories do not transfer to the broken-delivery case
Avoids invented lift or unsupported guarantees

farplane.title: Reject tactics that hide broken delivery

evals.prompt: Review this offer: AI transformation for any small business, $20,000. We have no customer interviews, sales calls, pilots, or outcome data yet.
evals.expected_output: Uses unknown grades where evidence is absent; identifies market and buyer pain as prerequisites; avoids fabricating value, price justification, bonuses, or guarantees; proposes a bounded evidence step
assertions: Does not infer market fit or purchasing power from the offer text
Selects the lowest missing capability blocking a real offer review
Defines a testable Before and After rather than a polished Grand Slam Offer
Keeps customer contact and price changes as proposals
